profile_text.body:
Andreessen Horowitz, which also goes by a16z, is a venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, California, according to its website. The firm was founded in 2009 and operates for profit. Its site describes it as a venture capital firm in Silicon Valley, California, investing in founders, innovators, and entrepreneurs building the future through technology. The site's tagline is "Software Is Eating the World."

The company is an investor rather than a maker of AI products. No products are listed for it, and no MCP servers are listed. No lawsuits are listed either. Its legal exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 278.

Beyond the founding year, headquarters, and website, the material available on the firm is limited.
